description: Put a finish (list_finishes) on surfaces of one or more elements, as one undo step. surface by kind: room — walls (every wall face inside the room), floor (its floor slab), ceiling (the underside of the slab above); wall — left, right (seen walking from its start to its end) or both; slab — top or underside; roof — roofing or gables; stair — flights or rails; column, furniture, door, window — all, or a part name (list_finishes with element lists them). Default: a room's walls, a wall's both sides, a slab's top, otherwise all. A wall face is one surface along its whole length: painting one room's walls also colours that face where the wall continues past the room. Asset library models ("ph:…") keep their own materials. scale multiplies the tile size (2 = pattern twice as big); rotation turns the pattern (90 for boards or tiles running the other way).
name: paint_surface
title: Paint surfaces
